            Native model vision direct pixels in Chat + built-in Agent view_image
            DeepSeek Vision-Exp and GLM 5.3 each use their matching engine-component encoder. The main ds4 runtime passes the correct one automatically.
            
    Scanning…
    
          
    
          
    
            Image workflows native vision, with no secondary visual router
            
    DeepSeek Vision-Exp or GLM 5.3 reads source pixels and decides whether a request creates or edits an image. DStudio then dispatches that explicit decision directly to the matching local image worker. Laguna and older text-only checkpoints cannot accept images and never fall back to another vision model.
    
            
    
              
    
                Image generation · creates images
                Ideogram 4 FP8 · official Quality-48 profile.
              
    
              
    
                Image editing · edits images
                Full HunyuanImage-3.0-Instruct NF4 · 50-step think_recaption profile.
              
    
            
    
            
    Ideogram, Hunyuan, H3 and DS4 remain serialized so heavyweight workers do not compete for unified memory.
    
          
    
        
    

        
    
          
    
            MiniMax H3 open weights native h3.c + Apple Metal; no generation API
            
    Checking…
    
            
            
    
              
              
              
            
    
            
            
    
              
              
              
            
    
            
    The first setup downloads the original official FL2VA tree used by h3.c: about 134 GiB (144 GB) for the BF16 transformer, Qwen text encoder, video VAE and audio VAE. It also compiles the pinned native engine; setup does not load or run the model. Balanced follows h3.c's validated 45-layer/reuse-2 controls; Quality is substantially slower. DStudio stops the chat model only during generation, and the one-shot native process releases every H3 weight before chat is restored.
    
            
    Two ordered reference photos use H3's separate Ref2VA path. Preparing it downloads the additional official transformer, about 61.7 GiB (66 GB); DStudio reuses the existing FL2VA encoder and VAEs instead of duplicating them.
    
            
    Native h3.c validates the official checkpoint layout, so converted ComfyUI weights and the former third-party encoder cannot be reused by this backend.
    
          
    
        
    

        
    
          
    
            Skill routing for the Agent searches only skills you created, by meaning and in any language
            
    Checking…
    
            
    
              
              
            
    
            
    A small local multilingual embedding model served by llama.cpp indexes every skill description so the Agent finds the right skill by meaning — including Italian and paraphrases — instead of literal keywords. It starts on demand and stops itself when idle. Without it, the Agent's skill search returns nothing (there is no lexical fallback). Install builds the index once (a few seconds); files live in ~/.dstudio/llama-embed.
    
          
    
        
    

        
    
          
    
            Conversations removes every local conversation
            
            
    Wipes the chat / roadmap / agent / design history on this machine, plus the on-disk model cache (KV) when the engine is idle. This cannot be undone.
